program:
PARAMS = {
    "R":        (150e3, 60e3, 300e3),
    "Q":        (0.65, 0.58, 0.69),
    "fc":       (34.5e3, 32e3, 37e3),
    "Itail":    (40e-6, 20e-6, 60e-6),
    "gmid_in":  (15, 10, 20),
    "L_in":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmid_p":   (10, 7, 13),
    "L_p":      (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmid_t":   (12, 8, 15),
    "L_t":      (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = spec.get("vdd", 1.8)
    R, Q, fc = p["R"], p["Q"], p["fc"]
    It = p["Itail"]
    Id = It / 2

    # --- filter: -3 dB point vs f0 for a 2nd-order LP with quality Q
    a = 1.0 / Q**2 - 2.0
    u = (-a + math.sqrt(a * a + 4.0)) / 2.0
    x3 = math.sqrt(u)
    f0 = fc / x3
    w0 = 2 * PI * f0
    # unity-gain SK with R1=R2=R: Q = 0.5*sqrt(C1/C2), w0 = 1/(R sqrt(C1C2))
    Cg = 1.0 / (w0 * R)
    ratio = (2 * Q) ** 2
    C1 = Cg * math.sqrt(ratio)   # feedback cap to vout
    C2 = Cg / math.sqrt(ratio)   # cap to ground

    # --- OTA: NMOS diff pair, PMOS mirror load, NMOS tail mirrored from ibias
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Id, vds=0.35)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], Id, vds=0.9)
    vs_tail = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.12)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], It, vds=vs_tail)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], iref, vds=mt.vgs)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.R("R1", "vin", "n1", R)
    n.R("R2", "n1", "n2", R)
    n.C("C1", "n1", "vout", C1)
    n.C("C2", "n2", "vss", C2)
    # OTA (+ = n2, - = vout)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "n2", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vout", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)

    # --- predictions
    A0 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    gain_db = db(A0 / (1 + A0))
    xs = 10 * fc / f0
    H = lambda xx: 1.0 / math.sqrt((1 - xx * xx) ** 2 + (xx / Q) ** 2)
    atten = -db(H(xs))
    pk = 0.0 if Q <= 1 / math.sqrt(2) else db(Q / math.sqrt(1 - 1 / (4 * Q * Q)))
    power = (It + iref) * vdd
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "fc": fc, "atten_db": atten,
               "peaking_db": pk, "power": power}
